properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 28 at 10:54AM CDT by NWS San Angelo TX
properties.description:
The threat for very heavy rainfall and significant flash flooding is
increasing across west central Texas mainly Tuesday night through
Thursday. The combination of the remnants of Hurricane Polo from the
Pacific, abundant tropical moisture and a cold front will result in
periods of very heavy rainfall which may produce localized
significant flash flooding. Looks like the heaviest rainfall will

properties.headline: Flood Watch issued September 28 at 5:51AM MDT until September 30 at 6:00AM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Southwest New Mexico including Dona Ana, Otero, Luna,
Sierra, Grant, and Hidalgo Counties. Far West Texas, including El
Paso and Hudspeth Counties.

* WHEN...From noon MDT today through late Tuesday night.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood
properties.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WATCH REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM NOON MDT TODAY THROUGH LATE TUESDAY NIGHT
